meta.name: TA-ai-governance
meta.displayName: Enterprise AI Governance App for Splunk

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Configure AI provider accounts and add-on logging

entity.label: Name
entity.help: A unique name for this AI provider account.

validators.errorMsg: Account Name must begin with a letter and consist exclusively of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
Length of account name should be between 1 and 100

entity.label: AI Provider
entity.help: Select the AI provider this account connects to.

entity.label: Anthropic Admin/Compliance API key
entity.help: Anthropic Admin or Compliance API key (sk-ant-admin...) with compliance scopes. Used for the Compliance Activity Feed and Directory inputs.

entity.label: Anthropic Analytics API key
entity.help: Optional. Key with read:analytics scope for usage and cost analytics. Leave blank to reuse the Admin/Compliance key.

entity.label: OpenAI Admin API key
entity.help: OpenAI organization Admin API key (sk-admin-...) with api.audit_logs.read and usage scopes. Only an organization Owner can create one (platform.openai.com > Settings > Organization > Admin keys).

validators.errorMsg: Enter an OpenAI organization Admin API key (sk-admin-...). Only an organization Owner can create one under platform.openai.com > Settings > Organization > Admin keys. Project keys (sk-proj-...) cannot read audit logs.

entity.label: Google OAuth Client ID
entity.help: OAuth 2.0 client ID authorized for the Admin SDK Reports API (admin.reports.audit.readonly scope).

entity.label: Google OAuth Client Secret
entity.help: OAuth 2.0 client secret.

entity.label: Google OAuth Refresh Token
entity.help: Refresh token for a Workspace admin authorized with the admin.reports.audit.readonly scope.

entity.label: Google Workspace Customer ID
entity.help: Optional. Workspace customer ID; defaults to my_customer.

entity.label: Microsoft Entra Tenant ID
entity.help: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) tenant ID.

entity.label: Microsoft Application (client) ID
entity.help: App registration client ID with AuditLogsQuery.Read.All and Reports.Read.All application permissions (admin consented).

entity.label: Microsoft Client Secret
entity.help: App registration client secret.

entity.label: Server base URL
entity.help: Base URL of the self-hosted LLM server, e.g. https://vllm.example.com or https://ollama.example.com:11434. HTTPS strongly recommended; HTTP requires the checkbox below.

validators.errorMsg: Base URL must start with http:// or https:// and contain no spaces.

entity.label: Server type
entity.help: Determines which endpoints are used for model inventory, runtime state and metrics.

entity.label: API key / bearer token
entity.help: Optional. Sent as Authorization: Bearer for servers with auth enabled (vLLM --api-key, LiteLLM master key). Leave blank for open endpoints.

entity.label: Allow plain HTTP (lab / on-prem only)
entity.help: Permit http:// base URLs for internal lab servers. Never enable for endpoints reached over untrusted networks; Splunk Cloud deployments should always use HTTPS.

entity.label: Proxy URL
entity.help: Optional HTTPS proxy URL (e.g. http://proxy.example.com:8080) used for outbound API calls from this account.

validators.errorMsg: Log level must be one of: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL
